As a kid, I used to read a lot, but throughout the years I lost the habit and only regained it a few years ago. I don't have much spare time to read, but whenever I have a bit, it's one of my favourite activities. I honestly wish I could dedicate more time to it. 

The "Mistborn" saga (Era 1 in particular) is one of the trilogies that sparked my love for reading once again, you should give it a try! You can also check out my Goodreads profile to see what I'm up to.

This object was supposed to be super cool and interactuable, having different music genres and songs within them. 

But.

Due to limitations of the tool im making this with, that wasn't possible. So... now what?

I guess you can checkout my last.fm (or whatever im using to track my music usage at the time of you seeing this). Check it out on the desktop!
These are my cats! I love them so much. I won’t tell you which one is which; I’ll let you guess (you should be able to do it pretty easily).

I have had, have, and will have a ton of hobbies, but this one deserves an honorable mention.
Since 2020, it’s been the only one that has managed to maintain my excitement in spite of the years. It has accompanied me throughout many stages of my life, both good and bad. I have met many people and learned many things solely thanks to it.
It’s probably worth mentioning that I have a dedicated online persona for them, which you can find under the name Microkeebs. If you want to see more, feel free to turn on the computer and explore a bit.

Although I don't have a big watch collection, I like watches. Not an absurd amount, but probably more than most people due to my love for fashion. My favourite one is the Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch Professional, particularly on the black on stainless steel colorway. Not only it has sentimental value to me, but its also wore by Light Yagami in Death Note and Koyomi Araragi in Kizumonogatari (from the Monogatari Series). 

Though I would like to mention that Light doesn't wear this specific model, he wears a re-edition of the Speedmaster Mark II exclusive to the Japanese market, called the Speedmaster Japan Racing Special. Just a fun trivia fact =)

This is Quarzite, my OC (Original Character).
I designed them back in 2020 as a way to personify my digital self.

Its appearance is defined by a white wolf-cut with purple tips, prominent black horns marked with white crosses, and large pointed ears. This is complemented by red eyes with heart-shaped pupils and a fanged smile. Their outfit consists of an oversized color-blocked hoodie, buckled thigh-highs, and winged sneakers.
